summary: A user transferred XRP from Kraken to a non custodial Coinbase wallet and added an unnecessary destination memo. The XRP balance did not appear in the wallet and Coinbase support stated that XRP was not supported.
user_mistake: transferred XRP to a wallet without confirming asset support and memo requirements
prevention: Confirm XRP support and destination memo requirements before withdrawing from an exchange / Verify wallet compatibility with a small transfer first
